question.problem:
Consider the bilinear form $B(x,y),$ given by 

$$
B(x,y)={x}_{1}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+{x}_{1}{y}_{3}-{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{1}.
$$

 

Evaluate $B(x,y)$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$\,$ $x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,y=[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2} \\ {y}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$

Substituting these into the bilinear expression, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & ={x}_{1}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+{x}_{1}{y}_{3}-{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{1}. \\  & =0\cdot 2-2\cdot 0\cdot 1+0\cdot 2-1\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot 2 \\  & =0-0+0-1-2 \\  & =-3.\end{aligned}
$$
